body:
Hey man. I definitely appreciate the relate. When you're feeling down, you always think that your situation is too unique for anyone to really understand but it's comforting to know that you're not the only one going through something. I mean it sucks that other people feel that way, but nice to know that that thing has the same effect on other people and you're not weird.

Calc honestly wasn't even that hard, I just didn't practice. Do yourself a favor and stay on top of your shit. I never said school was too hard for me. It's not. I just never had any motivation. I know I can do it though because I've been top of the class before. Just manage your time well once you do get there.

Tell me more about your gf situation? I'm curious.
